title: Linked flow test is not pytest-compatible when targeted
reasoning: Because the file is named test_flow.py and its helper functions start with test_, pytest will collect test_with_live_server as a test when the linked path is targeted. Its base_url parameter is a CLI argument concept, not a pytest fixture, so collection/execution fails with a missing fixture instead of running the intended CLI path through main().
reproduction: Run `python -m pytest scripts/test_flow.py`; pytest collects test_with_live_server(base_url) and errors because no base_url fixture is defined.
recommendation: Rename CLI helper functions so pytest does not collect them, or convert this file into real pytest tests with fixtures and keep the CLI entrypoint separate.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: This file is the linked test artifact; its collection shape prevents it from reliably serving as a regression test when invoked by pytest.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a real pytest module under tests/ that imports the script helpers with non-test names and exercises the isolated flow against the FastAPI app.
minimumFixScope: Rename test_with_live_server/test_with_testclient or move CLI code out of a pytest-discoverable test_*.py file.
